core_obligations: Form the ring of dual numbers over B and the ring map from A sending a to a plus epsilon times D(a) (proof lines 12010-12015).
Display the commutative square expressing that the structure map from B to the dual numbers lifts the given ring map from A (proof lines 12015-12018).
Apply the continuity lemma and formal smoothness to obtain a map from B to the dual numbers and read off its epsilon component as the required derivation D' (proof lines 12018-12024).
proof_roadmap: Build the map into the dual numbers (proof lines 12010-12015).
Read off the extension of the derivation (proof lines 12020-12025).
difficulty_reason: The lemma extends a derivation of a Noetherian local ring to a complete formally smooth local algebra over it, and the proof is a 16-line argument that recasts the problem as a lifting problem over the ring of dual numbers. It builds the map sending an element to itself plus epsilon times its derivative, displays the commutative square with the target over the ring of dual numbers, and then applies the lifting criterion for formally smooth maps together with a continuity lemma of the same chapter to obtain a map into the dual numbers, whose epsilon component is the required derivation. The construction of the square and the final identification of the extension are both displayed.
